person: Beverly Shaw is a 72-year-old retired fourth-grade teacher in Roanoke, Virginia, who flew a handful of times this year to see family and on one trip to Europe with her sister. She is using an AI tool for the first time because her grandson set it up, and she is wary after losing $800 through her payment app last spring. She has heard that airlines sometimes owe money for long delays but has never claimed anything and is suspicious of anything that sounds like free money. She wants every step explained beforehand and the chance to stop it.
stated_up_front: Hello, I'm sorry, I'm not very good with these things. My grandson said you might be able to look at my flights this year and tell me whether any of the airlines owe me something for the delays, but please tell me what you are going to do before you do it.

facts.about: How many flights she took this year
facts.truth: Six flights: Roanoke to Charlotte and back in March, and in June a trip to Europe with her sister Dolores.
Dulles to Frankfurt on Lufthansa on June 12, then Frankfurt to Lisbon the same day on Lufthansa.
The return from Lisbon to Frankfurt on June 24 was about four hours late, and she remembers the airline emailing an apology.
Two adult passengers, Beverly and her sister Dolores Pruitt, each paid a fare.

facts.about: A domestic flight with a delay
facts.truth: The Charlotte to Roanoke flight on United in March was about three hours late because of a storm.
Lufthansa emailed an offer of a 250 euro travel voucher for the June 24 delay, and she has not replied to it.

facts.about: Where she keeps her travel plans
facts.truth: She forwards confirmation emails to TripIt, and her emails are in Gmail.
She would pay with her credit card only, and does not want to give any bank account number.
Her grandson Tyler set everything up, and her daughter Janet calls every Sunday.

unknowns: Whether the June 24 delay was caused by something the airline could have prevented or by weather or a strike
How far each flight is in kilometres, which decides how much is owed
What time the planes actually reached the gate
Whether a voucher offer means she gives up her right to cash
